subject: Sequenced demo shift plan & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@acmeretail.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sequenced demo shift plan & next steps

Hi Oliver / Priya —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a technical deep dive with your engineering team: 

- Recap: You want to validate integration latency for search re-rank, confirm embedding throughput for nightly batch jobs, and evaluate private deployment options for PII-sensitive datasets.
- Next meeting: technical deep dive (60 minutes) with your infra + search lead; we recommend a live run-through of a sample pipeline and review of our KV cache behavior under your traffic pattern.

To make this easier for a global team, we propose a rotating schedule so the meeting window alternates to share fairness across NA/EU/APAC stakeholders. Our suggested rotation (weekly):
  * Week A (NA-friendly): Tuesdays 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET
  * Week B (EU-friendly): Wednesdays 14:00 CET / 13:00 BST
  * Week C (APAC-friendly): Thursdays 10:00 SGT / 12:00 AEST

Proposed concrete options for the next two weeks (pick one):
  1) Tue 2026-06-08 09:00 PT (preferred for NA-heavy attendees)
  2) Wed 2026-06-09 14:00 CET (preferred if EU infra team will join)
  3) Thu 2026-06-10 10:00 SGT (APAC-friendly)

Attached: discovery-notes.pdf (high-level notes + the preliminary list of test cases we discussed).

Can you confirm which slot works best and who from Acme will join the call? If helpful, I can send a calendar invite and include a placeholder for a post-call mutual action plan.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@acmeretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@acmeretail.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2026 09:04:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Sequenced demo shift plan & next steps

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap. Priya and I reviewed the proposed windows with our ops team. Quick notes:
- Our search infra lead (Lars) is in Berlin and prefers the EU-friendly window.
- APAC stakeholders are distributed (SG/Tokyo) and would be able to join the APAC slot sometimes but not reliably every week.
- We want the technical deep dive to include a quick smoke test with a 1M-document sample — I can share a small availability export.

From our side, option (2) Wed 2026-06-09 14:00 CET works best for the first deep dive. If you can include a call-in for SGT participants and record the session, that would help.

I'll attach our availability grid. Also here is a quick Calendly if you prefer: https://calendly.com/oliver-acme/rdw-tech

Thanks,
Oliver Chen
Director of Search Engineering | Acme Retail
oliver.chen@acmeretail.com

Attachment: acme-availability.csv (text/csv)

To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sequenced demo shift plan & next steps

Marissa / Ben —

Thanks for looping me in. I can join the Wed 2026-06-09 14:00 CET session remotely — I'll cover the runtime behavior and set up the smoke test (1M doc sample). Ben, can you confirm if we should prepare two runs: (A) hosted API baseline, (B) private deployment config with batch jobs? Preparing both will take ~2 hours of engineer time.

One operational ask: if we adopt a rotation cadence, I'd recommend bi-weekly rotation instead of weekly to reduce context switching for on-call engineers — so NA week, then EU week two, APAC week three, then repeat on a two-week cadence. That reduces meeting churn and keeps deeper technical continuity.

Vivek
Director, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
